David Clinging How is it reasonable to come to deny the existence of a God? If you insist there is no God, you are in the minority of the human race. People have rightfully understood for thousands of years that logically the world cannot exist without a Creator. If you look at the world, at the laws of physics that order our universe, and life, all we find is order, rationality, and design. How could something so brilliant come from nothing? Surely, there must be a Creator. It is fallacy to believe otherwise. Science did not truly take off until the rational theology of the Christian worldview demonstrated that the universe is ordered and rational because it is created by a rational being. Modern day "atheists" base their beliefs of the universe on rational science that came about from a rational Christian worldview. It's no wonder that the Western world which was largely influenced by a Christian worldview was technologically leaps and bounds ahead of other civilizations that lacked that Christian worldview. The recent worship of creation by atheists (or what they refer to as "science") is foolishness. Can creation speak? Can science explain right and wrong? Will it tell you why you exist? Will it fill the hole you long to fill?  "[God's] invisible attributes, namely, his eternal power and divine nature, have been clearly perceived, ever since the creation of the world, in the things that have been made. So [people] are without excuse. For although they knew God, they did not honor him as God or give thanks to him, but they became futile in their thinking, and their foolish hearts were darkened. Claiming to be wise, they became fools, and exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images resembling mortal man and birds and animals and creeping things." Romans 1:20-23  When creation, under the guise of "science", is put on a pedestal, you are worshipping the created thing, and ignoring the Creator. For you, science is your "image resembling mortal man and birds and animals and creeping things". Do you see how silly that is? It'd be like honoring a painting rather than its artist. Famous paintings are typically referred to by the name of their creator. The genius does not come from the Monet, it's just an object that had no control over its beautiful genius and creation. The true genius comes from the artist, Claude Monet himself! Science is merely a process by which humans learn about God's creation and marvel at its wisdom and complexity. Science is a wonderful thing when used to worship God for His creation and develop technology to further care for people in this world. (I don't know of anything more wise or astounding than the human body. What a beautiful awe-inspiring work of engineering!) But, God is denied and science is worshiped itself, then we have become so foolish, and the pursuit will fail us.
